title: Historical memory prices 1960-2026
ai_summary:
• The first commercial computer memory was a vacuum tube-based system, costing around $10,000 per byte in 1959.
• By 1969, integrated circuit memory prices dropped to $1.20 per byte, a significant reduction.
• Since then, memory prices have continued to decline, reaching $0.032 per byte in 2026.
